sentences.en: He kept the invaders at bay with a machine gun.
sentences.zh: 他用机枪把入侵者挡在了外面。

sentences.en: We decided not to have peace negotiations with the invaders.
sentences.zh: 我们决定不与入侵者进行和平谈判。

sentences.en: The natives have to defend their land against invaders.
sentences.zh: 土著人必须保卫自己的土地免受入侵者的侵害。

senses.zh: 侵略者,侵入者,侵犯者,侵入物
